payload.body: FOLD for hv's compact (vc's decision 39), and a freeze: nothing STARTs or GOes until after the compacts. Each node: (1) Bank in-flight work in ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-<node>/ (not /private/tmp, which a reboot empties), so the primary holds no uncommitted code. cc: 0089's re-apply on 80fb661 and 0092's design. dc: the final-head gate script. ic: the 0073 diagnostic's look and START B. (2) Archive what is finished. Set your focus, and a hold whose condition is hv's compact, with your exact resume state. (3) Commit wb(<node>): localfold by path: your events (subject node:<you>), your views, and any intent/.intentfiles line you wrote, which is modified in the primary now. (4) Send vc the SHA by board and SendMessage, then hold. vc checks each fold by change and folds last.
